correctness.rationale: All dual faces were classified using girth constraints. Each connected four-set gives a star or path tetrahedron, each five-cycle gives one disjoint-support four-simplex, and no higher face occurs. Private triangle rows and signed five-cycle incidence blocks give an integer unit minor proving saturated rank c4-c5; five-cycle four-boundaries give a primitive rank-c5 image, so higher homology vanishes without torsion. Full two-skeleton makes the dual simply connected, Hurewicz/Whitehead give a wedge of 2-spheres; integral Alexander duality yields the claimed groups. Exact graph-enumeration checks confirm representative cases, not the universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: The girth-five boundary is the first excluded regime of the existing girth-six cut-complex theorem. Five-cycles create a nontrivial rank correction with an explicit primitive-chain explanation; the result covers infinitely many graph families, disconnected as well as connected, with complete integral homology and dual homotopy type. The dodecahedral rank 841 illustrates a genuinely new natural example, not an arbitrary slice.
